highlights: 修复 Chrome 扩展和独立 Cookie 助手仍强制要求 hatch_gw 的问题；现在与服务端一致，只要求核心会话令牌。
修复视频遭 Muse 纯文字拒答时等待满 600 秒：稳定识别地区不可用等拒答并向调用方返回原文，长期无响应任务也会提前终止。
视频任务进度改为真实页面里程碑，不再用等待时间伪装成 92% 完成度。
合并 PR #32：图片生成、图片编辑与图生视频支持最多 4 张有序参考图。
多参考图增加字段冲突、无效项、MIME、单图 10 MiB 与总计 24 MiB 限制，并限定 composer 内附件计数。
参考图默认禁止服务器本地路径及私网/本机 URL；公网下载逐跳复查重定向并固定已验证 IP，可由可信管理员显式恢复旧能力。
修复同一账号连续查询额度时复用上次 Settings UI 导致的偶发失败；每次额度读取现在使用独立一次性页面，避免账号串页和菜单残留。
修复浏览器扩展下载包遗漏 _locales 子目录的问题，确保中英文扩展名称与说明随 ZIP 正确发布。
highlights_en: Fixed the Chrome extension and standalone cookie helper incorrectly requiring hatch_gw; import requirements now match the server.
Video tasks now surface stable Muse text refusals such as regional unavailability instead of waiting the full 600-second timeout; stalled new-thread submissions also stop early.
Video progress now reports observed page milestones rather than a time-based fake 92%.
Merged PR #32: image generation, edits, and image-to-video accept up to four ordered reference images.
Added conflict, item, MIME, per-image 10 MiB and aggregate 24 MiB validation, plus composer-scoped attachment counting.

Reference images now deny server-local paths and private/loopback URLs by default; public downloads recheck every redirect and pin the validated IP, with explicit trusted-admin opt-ins for legacy access.
Fixed intermittent failures on consecutive quota reads by using a fresh disposable page for every read, preventing stale Settings UI and cross-account page reuse.
Fixed extension ZIP packaging so nested _locales resources are included and English/Chinese metadata ships correctly.
